executive_summary.text: Cost year 2024: dietary cost per resident day ($13.07) was 44% of the Connecticut median ($29.6). Ask how dietary is handled: by the home's own staff, by a contracted service, or with costs reported in another department.
Cost year 2024: direct care cost was $55.17 per resident day (29.2% of expenses); Connecticut median $169.07.
Cost year 2024: nursing home operating margin was -16.2% (Connecticut median 0.5%).

Cost year 2024: dietary cost $188,094, $13.07 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.6). Wages $60,440 (32.1%), allocated fringe $6,624 (3.5%), non-wage costs $121,030 (64.3%). Raw food was $111,874 ($7.78 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.59).
Cost year 2024: housekeeping cost $90,987, $6.32 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.07). Wages $66,953 (73.6%), allocated fringe $7,337 (8.1%), non-wage costs $16,697 (18.4%).
Cost year 2024: laundry cost $49,481, $3.44 per resident day (Connecticut median $5.41). Wages $39,920 (80.7%), allocated fringe $4,375 (8.8%), non-wage costs $5,186 (10.5%).
Missing data: cost years 2019, 2020 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
